ledger.why: the casting line (the roles carry it)

collection.description: A teen announces they are cooking dinner tonight, all of it, alone: stay out of the way, or offer one piece of advice.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (subject) has announced that (subject.he/she) is cooking dinner tonight. All of it. Alone. Nobody is allowed near the fire. (friend) has been banished to the doorway, from where (friend.he/she) can hear a lot of clattering, one small yelp, and, at one point, (subject) saying "no, no, no" to a fish.

a__fx.name: Answer A
a__fx.text: (friend) stays in the doorway, as instructed, for a very long time. At last (subject) brings out the food: fish that is a little black on one side, roots that are a little hard in the middle, and a sauce nobody has ever seen before. (subject) watches (friend.him/her) taste it, barely breathing. It's actually good. Not perfect. Good. (friend) has seconds, and means it.

text_only.reason: food in the story (a meal, a snack, a basket of fruit); the village's stores do not change

b__fx.name: Answer B
b__fx.text: "Just one thing," calls (friend) from the doorway. "Turn the fish." There is a pause. "I KNOW," says (subject). Then, a moment later, the sound of a fish being turned. Dinner is good. Neither of them mentions the fish. (subject) is quietly very proud, and announces that (subject.he/she) will cook again next week, whether anyone likes it or not.
